learning_outcomes.text: The student is able to independently assess the suitability of the welding method for a given application.
The student knows the basic methods of joining metals.

syllabus_topics: Classification of welding and joining processes
Phase transformations in the weld and heat affected zone
Basic and supplementary materials for welding
Gas-shielded arc welding MIG / MAG methods
Laser welding, plasma and electron beam welding
Resistance pressure welding, spot and linear pressure welding, upset and flash welding
Thermal cutting methods: oxygen cutting, plasma cutting
Deformation and welding stress and methods for their reduction
Inspection of welded joints, imperfections definitions and methods for their detection
LABORATORY: Manual arc welding with coated electrodes
assessment_rules: To pass the subject, a threshold of 56.0% is required for both Laboratory short tests and the Written test.
